stories.title: ‘He lit up the room’: Bradford community remembers teacher, coach and chaplain Robbie Best
stories.summary: From prayers before games to smiles at the school gate, students and families share how Robbie Best made them feel seen, encouraged and loved.

stories.title: Jacksonville woman charged with animal cruelty after three dead dogs found in hotel room
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office says officers responded after hotel management had been notified of a "noxious and unpleasant" smell.

stories.title: 'Something you should take seriously': Putnam County braces for weeks of flooding
stories.summary: Putnam County braces for major flooding as rising St. Johns River water threatens homes and roads. Residents are urged to prepare and avoid flooded roads.

stories.title: Former Nassau County banker accused of stealing $26,500 from customer, deputies say
stories.summary: The Nassau County Sheriff's Office says that the man used personal identifiying information to gain access to the victim's account to make the transactions.

stories.title: Stop-work order, daily fines and foreclosure: What’s happening with these Nassau County homes
stories.summary: An unfinished home in Nassau County faces fines and foreclosure as former business partners trade blame in a federal bankruptcy dispute.

stories.title: 13-year-old arrested in Flagler County after posting school shooting threat to TikTok
stories.summary: In the post shared to TikTok, the teen wrote "school better be canceled tmr or i will shoot everyone."

stories.title: Jacksonville City Council members propose a one-year pause on hyperscale data centers: What's next?
stories.summary: The proposed one-year moratorium on data centers would give city leaders time to study the potential impacts.

stories.title: Columbia County Sheriff's Office to launch Special Needs Registry program
stories.summary: The voluntary program aims to help law enforcement and emergency responders aid individuals with special needs as efficiently as possible.

stories.title: 'Will be greatly missed': Bradford High School teacher dies after medical emergency at school
stories.summary: The Bradford County School District announced the death of Robbie Best, who was found unresponsive in his classroom by fellow teachers, the sheriff's office said.

stories.title: Putnam County opens sandbag sites ahead of expected St. Johns River flooding
stories.summary: County officials say rain, combined with astronomical king tides, is expected to push river levels into moderate and major flooding.

stories.title: JTA board approves financial recovery plan amid budget crisis
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Transportation Authority's new financial recovery plan aims to save $47 million through spending cuts and improve accountability.

stories.title: Charges in St. Johns County fraudulent voter guide case dismissed for a second time
stories.summary: The charges were dismissed by the same judge who dismissed the case in circuit court, arguing that the statute of limitations had passed.
